title: Ghazi Uth Vekh
body:
Teray Badoun Qaidna Hogaiyaan, Saday Saar Gaye Nay Khaimay, Aj Mukh Gaye Marn Bhira.
<<DIVIDER>>
May Tay Bulayaa Tenu, Chadaar Day Lain Vaylay Paar
May Tay Bulayaa Tenu, Us Vaylay, Vain Poundee Rayhi
Haye Ghazi Ghazi Kaikay, Arshan Town Maa Zahra.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kulsoom Nay Jadoun Dah, Teri Mout Baaray Sunayaa Ai,
Kulsoom Nay Jadoun Dah, Oh Ujri Vain Eho Karay
May Bay Aulaad Hogayi, Aj Maar Gaya Putar Mera.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kee Haal May Sunavaan, Teri Ladali Sakina Da
Kee Haal May Sunavaan, Ro Ro Kay Na Tera Lehndi Ay
Jadoun Vekh Di Ay Chera, Babay Day Katil Da.
<<DIVIDER>>
Asghar Day Sir Nu Taak Kay, Eho Kaindaa Ay Fazal Tera
Asghar Day Sir Nu Taak Kay, Jay Bhacheyaan Houn Na Rasiyaan
May Vekhaan Keevain Bachday, Katil Fair Asghar Da.
<<DIVIDER>>
Saqlain Moujza Ay Aj, Ghazi Day Alaam Kouloun
Saqlain Moujza Ay Aj, Saab Duniyaa Chadraan Lain Di Ay
Behna Day Vastay Payi, Ek Zainab Da Sadka.
